mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id, d.work_case_id AS work_case_id, d.document_type AS doc_type, d.status AS status, d.issued_on AS issued_date, d.expires_on AS expires_date, dv.id AS version_id, dv.version_no AS version_no, dv.version_type AS version_type, dv.storage_key AS storage_key, dv.mime_type AS mime_type, dv.checksum AS checksum, contract.employer_id AS contract_owner_user_id, contract.worker_id AS contract_worker_user_id, owner_user.name AS owner_name, worker_user.name AS worker_name, wp.id AS workplace_id, wp.name AS workplace_name FROM documents d JOIN users owner_user ON owner_user.id = d.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND ( (d.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT' AND dv.version_type = 'SIGNED' AND dv.version_no = 2) OR (d.document_type = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND dv.version_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND dv.version_no = 1) ) LEFT JOIN work_contracts contract ON contract.work_case_id = d.work_case_id LEFT JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = d.work_case_id LEFT JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id LEFT JOIN users worker_user ON worker_user.id = contract.worker_id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT share.id FROM document_shares share JOIN documents d ON d.id = share.document_id JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = share.work_case_id JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id WHERE share.document_id = #{documentId} AND share.shared_with_user_id = #{userId} AND share.purpose = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND share.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.owner_user_id = wc.worker_id AND wc.employer_id = #{userId} AND d.document_type = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND d.expires_on >= #{today} AND wc.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND #{now} < wc.ends_at AND wp.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND wp.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY share.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
